1.  Prayer in this petition is for quashing of the FIR No.55 dated 26.04.2019, under Sections 120-B,
406, 420 of IPC (Annexure P-1), registered at Police Station Phase 11, Mohali and all other subsequent proceedings arising therefrom on the basis of the compromise/affidavit dated 15.06.2019 (Annexure P-2).
2.

Keeping in view the fact that the parties entered into a compromise, this Court vide order dated 15.11.2023 directed the parties to appear before the Illaqa Magistrate/trial Court for getting their statements recorded in that regard.

Pursuant thereto, a report dated 13.12.2023 has been received from the Judicial Magistrate Ist Class, SAS Nagar Mohali, stating that the compromise arrived at between the parties is voluntary and the same is without any pressure, coercion or undue influence.

sentences.text: The power under Section 482 Cr.P.C. can be exercised in such matters.

It has been held by Supreme Court of India in cases Gian Singh v. State of Punjab and another 2012(10) SCC 303 and Narinder Singh and others v. State of Punjab and another 2014(6)
SCC 406 that criminal cases having overwhelmingly civil character, particularly those arising out of commercial transactions or matrimonial relationships or family disputes, should be quashed when the parties have resolved the disputes among themselves in a bona fide manner.
